mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the CPIAUCSL index above 216.995 (vintage 2008-10-01) signals accelerating inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain non-negative despite the CPIAUCSL crossing above 216.995, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of UNRATE above 6.8% (vintage 2008-11-01) indicates weakening labor market conditions, generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive despite the UNRATE crossing above 6.8%, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) over the 60-day horizon.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in UNRATE below 6.8% and PAYEMS below 135541.0 (vintage 2008-11-01) reflects a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns fail to rise significantly when both UNRATE < 6.8 and PAYEMS < 135541.0, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase marked by GDPC1 above 16854.295 (vintage 2008-07-01) and INDPRO above 93.4715 (vintage 2008-11-01), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns fail to rise significantly during the regime condition, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) when both proxies meet their thresholds.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in GDPC1 indicates strengthening economic demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns do not rise significantly during GDPC1's upward trend, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A crossing of INDPRO above 93.4715 (vintage 2008-11-01) signals strengthening supply conditions, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain non-positive despite the INDPRO crossing above 93.4715, or the effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of FEDFUNDS below 0.39 (vintage 2008-11-01) and UNRATE below 6.8% reflects accommodative monetary policy and strong labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns fail to rise significantly when both FEDFUNDS < 0.39 and UNRATE < 6.8, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
